steps.do: For each card separately, ask whether the customer wants expedited shipping (2-3 business days) and give that card's tier fee. Entry tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze): $15.00. Mid tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom): $10.00. Premium tier and above (Gold, Business Gold, Platinum, Business Platinum, Diamond Elite): $0.00. Standard shipping (7-10 business days) is free. If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited shipping. When a fee applies, get the customer's consent to it.

steps.do: Tell the customer the following. The old card is cancelled and no longer works for new purchases. The new card has a different number and CVV, and the account number stays the same. Give the delivery time counted from today's order: standard 7-10 business days, expedited 2-3. Tell them to watch for emails when the order is placed and when the card ships, and to update saved card details with merchants. If the reason was fraud_suspected or stolen, remind them to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges.
steps.quote: The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

basis.quote: Communicate the expected delivery window based on the selected method (standard: 7–10 business days; expedited: 2–3 business days).
A new card is created with a different card number and CVV.
Your account number remains unchanged, so recurring payments linked to your account continue without interruption.
Advise the customer to watch for email notifications when the order is placed and when the card ships.
Update any saved card details with merchants after you receive the new card.
If the reason was fraud_suspected or stolen, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges in the app or website.
